source: OpenStreetMap / ODbL, corroborated with architect KPF Lotte World Tower project
identityStatus: Name-confirmed containing tower outline (parent building relation 8824257) with exact-QID node 12520558001 inside; parent relation currently carries the wrong mall QID Q12616233. Candidate Q494895 and KPF project identify this unique 555 m tower.
axis: +X points northwest along the two opposed mapped basal seam tips, toward historic Seoul as stated by KPF; -X southeast. +Z points northeast. The two top ear footprints are on opposite +Z/-Z sides; their gap crosses the top approximately along +X/-X.

geometry.outlineRole: tower ground footprint, excluding adjacent Lotte World Mall

registration.method: Midpoint and directed axis between the opposite narrow basal facade seam tips; uses pairs of bounding tip vertices to avoid the tiny mapped seam notch.
limits: Mapped building parts are 2021 outlines with incomplete min-height tags and simplifications. Use them for compass phase and plan only, not to infer literal vertical extrusions.
The relation Wikidata mismatch is preserved as a data defect, not accepted as exact identity. Exact tower node plus relation name and 555 m height corroborate identity.
Use current published 555 m envelope rather than rounding the 554.5 m part height into a surveyed dimension.
